ExposureBasis.description: Provenance and basis of all observations in an XVA exposure profile.

oneOf.description: External complete exposure observations, supplied on a documented common basis.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the common netting, collateral and model-time policy.

source_id.description: Stable identifier of the source data and its completeness attestation.

oneOf.description: A portfolio repriced on every path and date before taking positive and negative parts.

path_count.description: Number of complete simulated paths including any antithetic partners.

source_id.description: Fingerprint of the pricing, market, portfolio and process inputs.

ExposureDiagnostics.description:
Diagnostics from exposure simulation capturing data quality metrics.

Populated by the exposure computation engine to let callers distinguish
genuine zero exposure from missing data.

market_roll_failures.description: Number of time grid points where market data could not be rolled forward.

valuation_failures.description: Total number of individual instrument valuation failures across all time points.

description: Exposure profile computed at each time grid point.

as_of.description: Valuation cut and required opening observation date.

basis.description: Provenance of the exposure model and the complete observation grid.

currency.description: Reporting currency shared by all marks, exposures and adjustments.

dates.description: Strictly increasing calendar observations starting on the valuation cut.

diagnostics.description: Completeness counters for the admitted grid. Failed points or valuations invalidate it.

ene.description: Expected Negative Exposure at each time point: max(-V(t), 0).

epe.description: Expected Positive Exposure at each time point: max(V(t), 0).

mtm_values.description: Portfolio mark-to-market value at each time point (may be negative).

times.description: Aligned model year fractions, starting at zero and strictly increasing.

title: ExposureProfile
